evals.prompt: I just sold the Epson scanner for $35. Update everything.
evals.expected_output: The inventory tracker is updated with Status=Sold, Sold Price=35, Date Sold=today's date for the Epson scanner item. Notes column is updated with the sale record.
expectations: The inventory tracker spreadsheet is modified (not just described)
The Epson scanner row has Status changed to 'Sold'
The Sold Price column is set to 35
The Date Sold column is set to today's date
Both FB Marketplace and Craigslist columns are updated to 'Sold'
The Notes column is updated with a record of the sale

evals.prompt: Some of my items have been listed for a while and aren't selling. Can you suggest revised prices?
evals.expected_output: A summary of all listed items with days-since-listing calculated, price revision suggestions for items older than 7 days using progressive discount tiers (10-15% at 7-13 days, 20-25% at 14-20 days, 30-40% at 21+ days), and items under 7 days skipped as too fresh.
expectations: The inventory tracker is read and all 'Listed' items are identified
Days since listing is calculated for each item
Items listed less than 7 days are skipped with explanation
Items listed 7+ days get a price suggestion with percentage drop shown
Suggested prices are rounded down to whole dollars
A clear summary table or list is presented to the user

evals.prompt: Show me what's still listed and what's already sold.
evals.expected_output: A status summary showing all items grouped by status (Listed vs Sold), with total asking prices, revenue from sold items, and days-since-listing for active items.
expectations: The tracker is read and items are grouped by status
Listed items show their asking price and days listed
Sold items show their sold price and date sold
Totals are shown for both groups
